<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<IATA_OrderCreateRQ xmlns="http://www.iata.org/IATA/2015/00/2019.2/IATA_OrderCreateRQ">
   <MessageDoc>
      <RefVersionNumber>1.0</RefVersionNumber>
   </MessageDoc>
   <Party>
        <Sender>
            <TravelAgency>
               <AgencyID>{{AgencyID}}</AgencyID>
               <ContactInfoRefID>AGENCY_1_CNT</ContactInfoRefID>
               <IATA_Number>{{IATA}}</IATA_Number>
               <Name>{{Agency_Name}}</Name>
               <TravelAgent>
                   <TravelAgentID>{{TravelAgentID}}</TravelAgentID>
               </TravelAgent>
            </TravelAgency>
        </Sender>
   </Party>
   <POS >
      <Country>
         <CountryCode>{{Country}}</CountryCode>
      </Country>
   </POS>
   <Request>
        <!-- OW example -->
        <CreateOrder>
            <SelectedOffer>
               <OfferRefID>{{OfferRefID}}</OfferRefID>
               <OwnerCode>LA</OwnerCode>
               <SelectedOfferItem>
                    <OfferItemRefID>{{OfferRefID}}</OfferItemRefID>
                    <PaxRefID>ADT_1</PaxRefID>
               </SelectedOfferItem>
            </SelectedOffer>
         </CreateOrder>
         <!-- RT example 
         <CreateOrder>
            <SelectedOffer>
               <OfferRefID>{{OfferRefID_Destination}}</OfferRefID>
               <OwnerCode>LA</OwnerCode>
               <SelectedOfferItem>
                    <OfferItemRefID>{{OfferRefID_Origin}}</OfferItemRefID>
                    <PaxRefID>ADT_1</PaxRefID>
               </SelectedOfferItem>
               <SelectedOfferItem>
                  <OfferItemRefID>{{OfferRefID_Destination}}</OfferItemRefID>
                  <PaxRefID>ADT_1</PaxRefID>
               </SelectedOfferItem> 
            </SelectedOffer>
         </CreateOrder>   -->
      <DataLists>
			<ContactInfoList>
				<ContactInfo>
					<ContactInfoID>AGENCY_1_CNT</ContactInfoID>
					<ContactPurposeText>BILLING</ContactPurposeText>
					<EmailAddress>
						<EmailAddressText>{{Agency_Email}}</EmailAddressText>
					</EmailAddress>
					<Phone>
                    <AreaCodeNumber>9</AreaCodeNumber>
                    <ContactTypeText>MOBILE</ContactTypeText>
                    <CountryDialingCode>54</CountryDialingCode>
                    <PhoneNumber>123456789</PhoneNumber>
               </Phone>
               <PostalAddress>
                  <CountryCode>CO</CountryCode>
						<PostalCode>10967</PostalCode>
						<StreetText>Boppstrasse 10</StreetText>
					</PostalAddress>
				</ContactInfo>
            <ContactInfo>
               <ContactInfoID>ADT_1_CNT</ContactInfoID>
               <EmailAddress>
                  <EmailAddressText>{{Customer_Email}}</EmailAddressText>
               </EmailAddress>
               <Phone>
                  <ContactTypeText>MOBILE</ContactTypeText>
                  <CountryDialingCode>57</CountryDialingCode>
                  <PhoneNumber>3216540987</PhoneNumber>
               </Phone>
            </ContactInfo>
         </ContactInfoList>
         <PaxList>
            <Pax>
               <CitizenshipCountryCode>CO</CitizenshipCountryCode>
               <ContactInfoRefID>ADT_1_CNT</ContactInfoRefID>
               <IdentityDoc>
                  <ExpiryDate>2025-09-23</ExpiryDate>    
                  <IdentityDocID>1116255993</IdentityDocID>
                  <IdentityDocTypeCode>P</IdentityDocTypeCode>
                  <IssuingCountryCode>CO</IssuingCountryCode>
               </IdentityDoc>
               <Individual>
                  <Birthdate>1992-09-23</Birthdate>
                  <GenderCode>M</GenderCode>
                  <GivenName>Oliver</GivenName>
                     <IndividualID>IND_Pax1</IndividualID>
                  <Surname>Jackson</Surname>
               </Individual>
               <PaxID>ADT_1</PaxID>
               <PTC>ADT</PTC>
            </Pax>
         </PaxList>
      </DataLists>
  </Request>
</IATA_OrderCreateRQ>

<IATA_OrderChangeRQ xmlns="http://www.iata.org/IATA/2015/00/2019.2/IATA_OrderChangeRQ">

    <Request>

				   <PaxID>INF_1</PaxID>

				</Pax> -->

                        <CardSecurityCode>347</CardSecurityCode>
                        <ExpirationDate>1224</ExpirationDate>
                    </PaymentCard>
                </PaymentMethod>
                <TypeCode>Credit Card</TypeCode>
            </PaymentProcessingDetails>
        </PaymentFunctions>     
   <!-->      <PaymentFunctions>
            <PaymentProcessingDetails>
                <Amount CurCode="COP">1167700.0</Amount>

                    <Cash></Cash>
                </PaymentMethod>
                <PaymentTrx>

                </PaymentTrx>
                <TypeCode>Cash</TypeCode>
            </PaymentProcessingDetails>
        </PaymentFunctions>    --> 
    </Request>
</IATA_OrderChangeRQ>
